raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner imposed an overly rigid and incorrect methodology—requiring the AKC breed page to explicitly contain the keyword “giant” and otherwise treating the breed as not giant. This misinterpretation of the task (fixating on a single-page keyword rather than established classification across credible AKC content or widely accepted breed consensus) risks a wrong conclusion, especially since Leonbergers are broadly recognized—and even described by AKC—as a giant breed. This criterion could have led to incorrectly classifying the Leonberger as “not giant” if the exact word wasn’t visible on the opened page.
